title: hoa.map
description: `hoa.map` spatializes multiple sources on a plane to control `hoa.2d.map~` or `hoa.3d.map`, allowing sources to be positioned, grouped, muted, described, colored, added, and removed. Sources and groups can be moved interactively or configured with messages using polar or Cartesian coordinates; `hoa.map` instances sharing the same `mapname` are linked and reflect one another’s changes.
